verdict.rationale: Bento's own marketing claims every release is "scored against your production history — offline, in CI, and on live traffic," which touches the offline-evaluation half of the story. There is no documented way to curate, select, or version datasets from production traces, and the evaluation claim is a single homepage line with no workflow docs. missing for 10: documented dataset curation from traces (selecting, labeling, versioning subsets), docs on how offline eval runs are configured and executed, independent or hands-on corroboration.
